# Playhouse West Dallas

Acting Training Classes in Dallas. Learn Meisner acting training with expert teachers at Playhouse West Dallas.

## Main Pages
- [Home](https://www.playhousewestdallas.com/) - Home page of Playhouse West Dallas.
- [About](https://www.playhousewestdallas.com/about-2) - About Playhouse West, our history, Robert Carnegie, Jeff Goldblum, and the Sanford Meisner Technique.
- [Audit a Class](https://www.playhousewestdallas.com/audit-1) - Information on auditing a class at Playhouse West Dallas, including auditing form.
- [Classes](https://www.playhousewestdallas.com/classes) - Acting class details, schedule, pricing, and curriculum.
- [Contact](https://www.playhousewestdallas.com/contact) - Contact information, location, phone, social links, and email.
